items.why: Guess matches the dog wading into the stream.
Survival instinct reading carries the meaning.
Guess says the town is the source of trouble; narration says it is almost a character, close but vague.
Link to Frank Dodd is read correctly.
Guess takes the groundwater poisoning loosely, missing the Dodd trauma metaphor.
Frightened man realizing the dog has rabies matches.
Branching line conveys illusion of choice with all paths ending the same.
Fear of watching her son die matches.
Guess frames running for the bat as self-defense, missing that it is the deadly, hopeless option.
Smokescreen reading matches, with supernatural inferred plausibly.
Guess says the supernatural is the narrative tool, but narration says Kemp (a character) is the tool.
